campaign.title: Atomically lower the provider cap and alter one dependent threshold.

initial.code:
FUNCTION G40_15_RENAMED(X)
  G40_15_RENAMED = X
  IF (X < 0) THEN
    G40_15_RENAMED = 0
  END IF
  IF (X > 113) THEN
    G40_15_RENAMED = 113
  END IF
  G40_15_RENAMED = G40_15_RENAMED
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION G40_15_PRED_1(X)
  G40_15_PRED_1 = 0
  IF (G40_15_RENAMED(X) >= 33) THEN
    G40_15_PRED_1 = 1
  END IF
  G40_15_PRED_1 = G40_15_PRED_1
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION G40_15_PRED_2(X)
  G40_15_PRED_2 = 0
  IF (G40_15_PRED_1(X) >= 56) THEN
    G40_15_PRED_2 = 1
  END IF
  G40_15_PRED_2 = G40_15_PRED_2
END FUNCTION
